intro.text: An old fisherman who works the bay of T'Telir by night.
A half-mad old fisherman from the Idrian dock slums of T'Telir, who pulls a strange sword from the bay.

items.text: Chapps fished the bay at night to avoid paying a tariff, and slumlords sometimes paid him to weigh down bodies and sink them there.

One night a voice in his head, which he took for the sea talking to him as it often did, told him where to cast his net. He hauled up a black sword in a silver sheath; it easily swayed his unsteady mind, asking whether he wanted to destroy evil, and he brought it ashore.
Vivenna tracked the sword down in a slum tenement, where she found it among several bodies, Chapps's among them.

personality.text: Not quite sane, he often hears the sea 'talking' to him.
